note: The five European research cities of the OneAquaHealth Horizon Europe project (Grant Agreement 101086521), with a viewport for each so the map and the demo open on a real urban catchment rather than a blank world. Coordinates are city centroids and the bounding boxes are generous: they frame the urban area, they are not stream reaches. Riffle works anywhere - these are entry points, not a restriction.

sites.about: Mondego basin. The project's community walks and macroinvertebrate sampling on urban streams ran here.
Confluence of the Calore and Sabato, a Mediterranean urban river system with strong seasonal flow.
Lowland, heavily canalised network of the Lys and Scheldt; hydromorphology is the dominant pressure.
Cold-water urban streams, many reopened from culverts - a European reference for daylighting.
Garonne and its urban tributaries, with summer low-flow and heat as the emerging pressure.
